verdict.rationale: Mangopay is a payments SaaS that handles user and transaction data, so a policy or control preventing that data from being used for AI training is a fair question. The pack has no evidence of such a setting or policy. The items cover payments, wallets, webhooks, SDKs, PCI-DSS, llms.txt and an MCP server, none of which address AI training use of customer data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
